description:
## Goal

Make PR #110 the semantic-correctness foundation and PR #118 the recalculator layer in one published GitHub stack:

```text
main
  -> PR #110 wt/kdt-close
       -> PR #118 fz-tfn/long-lived-recalculator
```

Replay every delivered PR #118 ticket commit onto the live PR #110 head in original order, reconcile each semantic conflict to one surviving authority, and establish a proven combined baseline before any other unfinished epic child proceeds.

This is integration work, not a mechanical history rewrite. Correct semantic identity must precede persistent reuse.

## Current ground truth

At the preflight immediately before integration:

- the exact common base is `a3a9761d1209165e5230625b9347cf6b0ad09b83`;
- PR #110 is draft, independently green, mergeable, based on `main`, and authoritative at `c2c723c63afdbda22078bb0a164cb313b8c7dfa8`: sixteen unique commits, +10,974/-1,682 across 75 files;
- PR #110 CI is green: lint 39 seconds and test 17 minutes 18 seconds;
- PR #118 is draft, independently green, mergeable, based on `main`, and authoritative at `63e55daa5836811bd44ee620247371bbbb1dbb73`: fifteen unique commits, +13,674/-6,531 across 72 files;
- PR #118 CI is green: lint 40 seconds and test 24 minutes 9 seconds;
- both PRs have zero reviews, issue comments, and inline review comments;
- the branches share exactly 26 changed paths;
- merge-tree reports exactly 15 conflict blocks in the same eight files: `.agent/docs/dispatch-matrix.md` (1), `.agent/docs/fact-engine.md` (1), `src/compiler2/canon.rs` (1), `src/compiler2/drive.rs` (1), `src/compiler2/drive_test.rs` (2), `src/compiler2/jobs/runtime_demand.rs` (2), `src/compiler2/types/canon.rs` (2), and `src/telemetry/public_trace_test.rs` (5);
- neither PR is currently registered as a GitHub stack;
- every integration and per-commit proof must use a unique branch-isolated `CARGO_TARGET_DIR`.

The last two PR #110 commits are part of the semantic foundation:

- `fz-kdt.210` makes an unread covariant occurrence produce `Underconstrained`; a partial lower-bound join is not a fact and must never be carved into a falsely narrow `Known` answer;
- `fz-kdt.120` deletes the empty-list binding cleaner without replacement; an observed `[]` is a fact, list-element `none` is ordinary bottom, and normal join owns the result.

Their combined meaning is mandatory. The stacked result must preserve the semantic repairs, recompute type, dispatch, causal, population, and telemetry ratchets on the combined implementation, and never select either parent branch constant by convenience.

PR #110 fixes semantic meaning, activation keying, brands, dispatch selection, partial joins, and empty-list bindings. PR #118 owns sharing, persistence, exact causality, and edge-triggered recalculation.

## Required combined model

- World owns authoritative interned semantic facts.
- Each retained root ProductMemo is the sole product authority and stores shared immutable answers.
- One dependency index ignites work from exact fact/product movement; no root, activation, waiter, or inventory scan is restored.
- Monotone cycles converge through ordinary per-key reactive formulas, not private cone/fixpoint solvers.
- Types owns one-denotation/one-Ty identity and one operation-tagged memoized comparison authority. Rendered or canonical strings remain display/debug output only.
- Callable resolution has one dependency-tracked authority.
- Native reuse is ultimately keyed by stable semantic body/content rather than whole-root remapping.
- An unread covariant occurrence never contributes a partial join as a fact.
- Empty-list bindings flow through the ordinary type algebra; no special cleaner or compatibility path returns.

## Strategy

1. Replace this description with live preflight truth before changing refs or histories; use no contradictory ticket comment.
2. Create explicit durable remote backup refs for exact pre-integration heads `c2c723c63afdbda22078bb0a164cb313b8c7dfa8` and `63e55daa5836811bd44ee620247371bbbb1dbb73`.
3. Create a new `fz-tfn.30` ticket branch and separate worktree from the live PR #118 head. Leave existing PR and scratch worktrees, including their user-owned untracked files, untouched.
4. Reset only the new ticket branch history to the live PR #110 head, then apply each of the fifteen original PR #118 commits in original order without committing.
5. After each apply, pause for a fresh cold ticket-scoped adversarial review against that original ticket description and the new parent. Resolve only changes already owned by that ticket. Commit with the original ticket message only after approval. Never close an old ticket again.
6. Preserve `fz-tfn.5` deletion of the standing root-entry scan. Translate PR #110 InputDemand gating into exact surviving dependencies; do not resurrect scanner authority.
7. Fold PR #110 construction-member seat/drop behavior into the dependency-tracked CallableResolution path; do not retain two edge constructors.
8. Route PR #110 production type ordering through typed, operation-tagged memoized comparisons; do not retain canonical/display-string or raw interner-order authority.
9. Combine brand refinement with binder-scoped typed canonical structure.
10. Recompute causal, population, and clone/identity ratchets from the combined implementation. Never choose a parent constant by convenience.
11. If a necessary reconciliation is not honestly owned by an original ticket description, leave it out of replayed history. Put it in this ticket single integration commit only when it is purely a branch-composition invariant. If it is a separable semantic or architectural feature, create a new child ticket, make it a dependency, and do not smuggle it into rebased history.
12. Give special scrutiny to `fz-kdt.47`, `fz-tfn.5`, `fz-kdt.163`, `fz-tfn.26`, `fz-kdt.5`, `fz-tfn.4`, and `fz-tfn.9`.
13. Add exactly one commit for this ticket containing required combined-model reconciliation, documentation, old-to-new commit mapping and proof record, final ratchet updates, and no temporary probe.
14. Prove the entire rewritten history and combined head with isolated build targets before moving the delivery branch.
15. Move `fz-tfn/long-lived-recalculator` only after the ticket branch is proven. Initialize the actual local stack with `gh stack init --base main wt/kdt-close fz-tfn/long-lived-recalculator`, run `gh stack rebase --no-trunk` as an inter-branch topology proof, and publish it with `gh stack submit`.
16. Preserve both existing PRs as draft and verify the remote stack and PR base order are exactly #110 -> #118.

## Required ticket/DAG re-evaluation

Before closing, rewrite affected open ticket descriptions to the combined ground truth, without contradictory comments. In particular:

- create or refine one reactive InputDemand ticket that deletes `derive_input_demand` / `solve_forwarded_demand` private cone work and expresses local, forwarded, returned-key, and later callable-identity demand as ordinary exact-dependency formulas;
- evaluate `fz-kdt.214` as the shared correctness prerequisite for direct, reconstructed, and projected forwarding edges before `fz-kdt.165`;
- evaluate whether `fz-kdt.213` folds into reactive InputDemand or blocks native incrementality/final acceptance;
- redefine `fz-kdt.165` as an additional dimension of the existing InputDemand fact, not another fact or cone;
- ensure `fz-tfn.13` can absorb and ultimately delete `fz-kdt.163` post-lowering whole-root remap/equivalence work;
- preserve `fz-tfn.10` through `.12` deletion of PullSession/World mirrors and reassess nested shared handles afterward;
- record a separate harness ticket if one corpus compilation can feed multiple permanent ratchets without weakening non-vacuity or failure attribution.

## Acceptance

- Durable remote backup refs name the exact pre-rebase PR heads before any shared branch is force-updated.
- #110 remains a clean, independently reviewable lower PR against `main`.
- #118 contains all fifteen delivered ticket changes, in original logical order, on top of #110 and shows only the recalculator layer in its PR diff.
- Every textual and semantic conflict has an explicit owner and one surviving authority; no both-path compatibility shim remains.
- No root-entry scan, duplicate callable-resolution constructor, display-string comparison authority, raw interner-order authority, empty-list cleaner, partial-join fact, or invented causal exception is introduced.
- `fz-tfn.9` clone/identity measurements are repeated on the combined population; temporary probes leave before commit.
- Exact structured causal reports are regenerated for all five request scenarios across 00420, predicate, and range fixtures and are cross-process identical with zero exclusions.
- Full library, CLI, all target doors, serial fixture matrix, formatting, diff checks, strict all-target/all-feature clippy, and documentation tests pass without controlled warnings, using branch-isolated Cargo target directories.
- Each rewritten ticket commit receives fresh ticket-scoped cold approval before its commit; the single integration commit receives its own cold review.
- A mapping from every old PR #118 commit hash to its rewritten hash and verification evidence is recorded in an agent-facing measurement/proof document.
- The actual GitHub stack is created and published. Both PRs remain draft, #118 targets `wt/kdt-close`, remote stack order is #110 -> #118, and CI is fully green.
- No unfinished epic child remains unblocked by this ticket.
- Temporary worktrees, conflict backups, probes, switches, and reconciliation scaffolding are removed after durable recovery refs and proof exist.
title: Stack recalculator work on semantic-correctness PR #110
